family: The single total deterministic-field family defined by proof.md and family.py. At actual length N enumerate primes2<=k<=N, r=ceil(N/k) and r-1 with r>=3,k>r+1, m=min(N,rk), ignored p=N-m, and2<=t<r. Use d=H+E0+1 from disperser.md Sections12--13, B=t(t+3)/2<=d<m, and choose the minimum(4p+8d-4B-3,k,t,p) including the zero option(4N,0,0,0). Construct Q_k by the supplied deterministic prime-degree specialization of Shoup in field.md and irreducible_prime(k), ignore p actual input bits, and evaluate the descending-power order-t symmetric polynomial on the remaining m bits over F2[Z]/Q_k with zero padding. No field-polynomial bits or advice are inputs.
theorem: This one fixed total language is in uniform P, hence NP with empty witnesses. The supplied binary linear-algebra/cyclotomic/trace algorithm constructs a deterministic irreducible degree-k polynomial for every selected odd prime k without an external oracle. The PRIME-DEGREE zero-deficit field theorem gives degree>=B on every dimension-d affine payload space; the retained full-B2 theorem gives4m-8d+4B+3. Thus C_B2(F_N)>=4N-L_N at every actual integer N. Optimizing ignored prefixes0<=p<=k requires only the two block counts and never exceeds the retained paid/compressed reference losses when present. Every sufficiently large integer N has L_N=O(N^(4/5))=o(N), so for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon with C_B2(F_N)>=(4-epsilon)N for every integer N>=N_epsilon in the full Li-Yang B2 model. In addition, for this exact selector L_N/N^(4/5) tends to C_star=10*2^(1/5) over all integer N. Thus for every epsilon>0, C_B2(F_N)>=4N-(C_star+epsilon)N^(4/5) at every sufficiently large integer N. Sharpness refers only to this computable certificate loss, not to optimal actual circuit sizes. The supplied derivation invokes the standard prime number theorem for its matching all-length parameter upper comparison.
